{{Quote|&hellip;yeah, I swore I'd never risk running up against Zaglis and his NFP goons again&mdash;not enough profit margin in it&mdash;but the way it happened was like this&hellip;|Valken Gresh, ''Great Hunts I've Lived To Tell About''|<ref name="GG10" />}}
'''Zaglis''' was an individual who held the title of [[Supreme Leader/Legends|Supreme Leader]] of the [[Neo-Fundamentalist Phlangites]], a group active on the<ref name="GG10" /> [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Zaraksander system/Legends|Zaraksander system]]</ref> astronomical object [[Zaraksander]].<ref name="GG10" /> At some point between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters]]'' is set between the events of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']] and [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], which corresponds to between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Valken Gresh]] brought in Zaglis, in the process escaping from the Neo-Fundamentalist Phlangite forces in Zaraksander's [[Fioer desert]].<ref name="GG10" />

The experience led Gresh to swear off facing Zaglis and his followers again, with the [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunter]] claiming such encounters did not have a sufficient profit margin. However, on the very next [[Standard day/Legends|day]], Gresh was forced to return to the Fioer [[Desert/Legends|desert]] and face the Neo-Fundamentalist Phlangites again after the hunter had been hired to rescue the kidnapped [[Cyrstas Eloinie|daughter]] of the [[Eloinie Petro-Munitions]]' [[Chief Executive Officer/Legends|Chief Executive Officer]], [[Darred Eloinie]]. Gresh later mentioned the encounters with Zaglis and his followers in the autobiographical work ''[[Great Hunts I've Lived To Tell About]]''.<ref name="GG10" />

==Behind the scenes==
Zaglis was introduced in "[[You Never Can Tell]]," a short companion narrative included in the [[1994]] sourcebook ''[[Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters]]''. The book was authored by [[Rick D. Stuart]] and published by [[West End Games]] for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="GG10" />
